entities.summary: Wojciech Bonawentura Fangor, also known as Voy Fangor, was a Polish painter, graphic artist, and sculptor. Described as "one of the most distinctive painters to emerge from postwar Poland", Fangor has been associated with Op art and Color field movements and recognized as a key figure in the history of Polish postwar abstract art. Wojciech Fangor was a writers & intellectuals from Warsaw (1922-11-15, Warsaw–2015-10-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
